reason: A structured AI coding workflow plugin that guides feature, issue, and refactoring tasks through planned stages, maintains task state, provisions workflow skills, and presents progress in a web task board.

summaries.zh: 为 AI 编程任务提供需求规划、方案设计、实现、审查和归档等阶段化工作流，并在项目中维护任务状态与进度看板。
summaries.en: Provides staged workflows for AI coding tasks, including planning, design, implementation, review, archiving, project task state, and web-based progress tracking.

capabilities: Injects workflow status reminders into agent conversations
Creates, updates, and archives task artifacts in allowlisted project directories
Supplies workflow skills and templates to project skill directories
Displays task stages and task-board summaries in the web interface
Provides configuration through web settings and user configuration files
